> Extraction textuelle : les tableaux complexes et diagrammes vectoriels peuvent nécessiter le PDF source.

6.342 rsNestedAggregateInPageSection
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsNestedAggregateInPageSection is a critical error that occurs when an aggregate function located in
the page header or page footer refers to another aggregate function in its Expression parameter.
